## What is this

- [ ] A new spell
- [ ] An edit to an existing spell
- [ ] A new discipline proposal
- [ ] Infrastructure / site change

## New spell checklist

(delete this section if not applicable)

- [ ] Copied from `TEMPLATE.md`, filled in, placed in the right
      `spells/<domain>/` folder
- [ ] Recorded clinically — no winking asides, no "unlike other spells..."
      commentary, no lampshading the joke (see `TEMPLATE.md` for the full
      reasoning)
- [ ] `Classes` is a flat list of 2-4 roles, no parentheticals/conditions
- [ ] Checked `MECHANICS.md` before naming a new phenomenon — reused an
      existing one if it fit
- [ ] If something genuinely new was needed, logged it in `MECHANICS.md`
      in this same submission
